intro: Legendary and Mythical Pokémon in COBBLEVERSE are never simple random encounters. Most are tied to the Poké Radar system from LumyMon (lumymon:poke_radar, crafted from iron and redstone around a Locator Chip found in bastion treasure, end city and ominous trial vault loot): upgrade the radar with type gems and key materials to track a legendary's structure, then bring the right summoning item to the altar inside. Others are guarded by the Legendary Monuments shrine system, hidden behind boss trainers of Team Rocket and Team Galactic, or simply roam the wild as ultra-rare natural spawns. Every method below is taken from the pack's own spawn data, recipes, loot tables and advancements.

legendaries.name: Articuno
legendaries.method: Craft the Articuno Radar (Poké Radar + Ice Gem + Never-Melt Ice + Blue Ice) to locate Articuno's tower. The Glacier Feather is found inside the tower itself — use it at the altar to summon Articuno at level 50.

legendaries.name: Zapdos
legendaries.method: Craft the Zapdos Radar (Poké Radar + Electric Gem + Cell Battery + gold) to locate Zapdos' tower. Retrieve the Thunder Feather inside and summon Zapdos (level 50–60) at the altar.

legendaries.name: Moltres
legendaries.method: Craft the Moltres Radar (Poké Radar + Fire Gem + Fire Stone + blaze powder) — its tower stands in the Nether. The Ember Feather found inside summons Moltres (level 50–60) at the altar.

legendaries.name: Galarian Birds (Dyna Tree)
legendaries.method: The Dyna Tree Radar (Poké Radar + Flying Gem + Dynamax Candy + glowstone) locates the Dyna Tree, where all three Galarian birds spawn at level 60: Galarian Articuno at night, Galarian Zapdos during thunderstorms, and Galarian Moltres by day.

legendaries.name: Mewtwo
legendaries.method: Recreate Team Rocket's experiment: place Ancient DNA (dropped by Gym Leader Giovanni) and a Cloning Catalyst (dropped by Rocket Admin Atena) into Cobblemon's Resurrection Machine. The revived Mewtwo has 2 guaranteed perfect IVs; a Radiant Cloning Catalyst yields a Shiny Mewtwo with 4. The Rocket Key reveals the Team Rocket Tower's coordinates.

legendaries.name: Mew
legendaries.method: Craft the Origin Fossil from any Cobblemon fossil, an Ancient Origin Ball and Ancient DNA, then awaken Mew (level 75–90) with it at the Mew Shrine in the Origin Temple.

legendaries.name: Raikou, Entei & Suicune
legendaries.method: All three Legendary Beasts spawn naturally at the Burned Tower structure — each with an equal one-in-three chance, level 60, ultra-rare bucket. The Burned Tower Radar (Poké Radar + Fire Gem + flint and steel) locates it.

legendaries.name: Lugia
legendaries.method: The Radio Card locates the Rocket Radio Tower in Johto, where Team Rocket boss Giovanni drops the Silver Wing. Use it at Whirl Island (found with the Lugia Radar) to summon Lugia at level 60–70.

legendaries.name: Ho-Oh
legendaries.method: Defeat the Old Sage for the Rainbow Wing, then summon Ho-Oh (level 60–70) at the Bell Tower, located with the Ho-Oh Radar (Poké Radar + Flying Gem + all five stat feathers + wind charge).

legendaries.name: Celebi
legendaries.method: Defeat the legendary trainer Red to claim the GS Ball, which reveals Celebi (level 75–80) within the Ilex Shrine.

legendaries.name: Regirock, Regice & Registeel
legendaries.method: Each golem sleeps in its own temple, located with a dedicated radar built from the matching type gem plus tumblestones: Regirock Radar, Regice Radar and Registeel Radar. The golems await inside at level 40–50.

legendaries.name: Latias & Latios
legendaries.method: The Eon Duo Radar (needs a Soul Dew) locates the Secret Garden. Hoenn Champion Rocco drops both dews: Ruby Dew attracts Latias and Sapphire Dew attracts Latios (level 50–75) at the garden's altar.

legendaries.name: Kyogre
legendaries.method: Craft the Ocean Core (Water Gem + Heart of the Sea) and use it within Kyogre's Submerged Temple, located with the Kyogre Radar. Kyogre appears at level 60–70.

legendaries.name: Groudon
legendaries.method: Blast-furnace the Geostone blocks found on Groudon's volcanic island into Molten Crust, craft the Earth Core (Molten Crust + iron block), and summon Groudon (level 60–70) atop the volcano. The Groudon Radar marks the island.

legendaries.name: Mega Rayquaza
legendaries.method: Forge the Sky Core from four treasures: the Aether Gem (from Lyris), Desolate Gem (Magma Leader Max), Primordial Gem (Aqua Leader Ivan) and the Emerald Emblem found in the Sky Pillar itself. Summon Mega Rayquaza (level 70–80) at the top of the Sky Pillar, located with the Mega Rayquaza Radar.

legendaries.name: Jirachi
legendaries.method: Find the Melodic Tape (Vol.1) inside the Wish Cave and play it at Jirachi's shrine to awaken it at level 75–80.

legendaries.name: Deoxys
legendaries.method: A Meteorite Crystal lies at Deoxys' fallen meteorite — use it to call Deoxys back to its shrine at level 75–80. The Deoxys Meteorite block (from Mega Showdown) later lets it change forms.

legendaries.name: Uxie, Mesprit & Azelf
legendaries.method: Defeat the three Team Galactic Commanders to reveal the hidden lakes: Jupiter in the Eterna Building (Acuity Proof), Mars at the Wind Plant (Verity Proof) and Saturn in the Galactic HQ (Valor Proof). Uxie (Lake Acuity), Mesprit (Lake Verity) and Azelf (Lake Valor) await at level 40–65, and each guardian grants its jewel of gratitude — needed to reforge a broken Red Chain.

legendaries.name: Dialga & Palkia
legendaries.method: Seize the Red Chain by defeating Cyrus at the Galactic HQ — or reforge a Broken Red Chain with the Knowledge, Emotion and Willpower Jewels of the Lake Guardians. Use it on the altars at Spear Pillar (located with the Space-Time Radar) to summon Dialga and Palkia at level 70.

legendaries.name: Heatran
legendaries.method: Combine the Heat Fragment (from Buck) and Heat Splinter (from Galactic scientist Charon) into a Magmatic Cluster, then reheat it in the Stark Forge to restore the Magma Stone. It summons Heatran (level 50–65) at its altar in Stark Mountain, a Nether fortress located with the Heatran Radar.

legendaries.name: Regigigas
legendaries.method: Forge the Titan Relic from the five elemental relics (Cryo, Draco, Metal, Pebble and Spark, mined from their matching LumyMon ores) and use it to awaken Regigigas (level 70–80) inside the Snowpoint Temple, located with the Regigigas Radar.

legendaries.name: Cresselia
legendaries.method: The Member Card (from Elfio) reveals Fullmoon Island, Cresselia's dwelling. Weave a Dream Catcher from Dream String (looted in the island's dream side) and a Lunar Wing, then channel it at Cresselia's altar (level 40–65).

legendaries.name: Darkrai
legendaries.method: Sleep holding the Moonlight Amulet to cross into the Nightmare Dimension on Newmoon Island. Loot Nightmare String there, craft the Nightmare Weaver (amulet + string) and use it at Darkrai's shrine to manifest it (level 40–65). Keep a Lunar Wing handy — it is your only way back out of the shadows.

legendaries.name: Manaphy & Phione
legendaries.method: The rare Manaphy Egg is recovered from Manaphy's hidden ocean shrine, and Manaphy itself appears there at level 50. Per the pack's advancements, Phione is obtained by hatching an egg (Cobbreeding handles Pokémon breeding and egg hatching in this pack).

legendaries.name: Shaymin
legendaries.method: Professor Oak's Letter, infused with Gracidea scent, invites Shaymin (level 50–55) to the Flower Paradise shrine — the letter is tied to the "Pallet Town Legacy" advancement (assembling the five first companions of Kanto). Each use fades the letter; restore a Faded Letter with a Gracidea Flower to call Shaymin again.

legendaries.name: Giratina
legendaries.method: Restore the Old Journal from a Torn Journal and Torn Page (both looted in the Team Galactic HQ and Wind Plant) to reveal Turnback Cave. Its depths hold a portal room into the Distortion World — a whole separate dimension — and cave chests can hold the Griseous Key. In the Distortion World, mine Distortion Origin Ore for Raw Origin (smelts to Origin Ingots, and 8 Raw Origin + an iron ingot craft a reusable Distortion Portal). The Giratina Radar then locates Giratina's Island, where the Renegade Pokémon lurks at level 75–95.

legendaries.name: Arceus
legendaries.method: Craft the Azure Flute from the Temporal Flute (from Damon), the Spatial Flute (from Perula) and an Origin Ingot. Hold right-click to play it and cross the dimensional veil to the Temple of Sinnoh, where Arceus awaits at level 70.

legendaries.name: Victini
legendaries.method: Spawns naturally in the Nether's crimson forest at level 50 (ultra-rare).

legendaries.name: Swords of Justice
legendaries.method: All four spawn naturally: Cobalion in windswept forests, Terrakion in savannas, Virizion in forests (each level 50–70), and Keldeo at level 60 (rarely 80) in Terralith's sakura groves and valleys.

legendaries.name: Forces of Nature
legendaries.method: Natural roamers: Tornadus over oceans, Thundurus in mountains, Landorus in badlands during clear weather (all level 50–60), and Enamorus in mountains at level 50.

legendaries.name: Tao Trio
legendaries.method: Reshiram spawns in mountains during clear weather and Zekrom in mountains during thunderstorms (both level 70–84); Kyurem appears in ice spikes while it rains (level 66–78). Craft the DNA Splicers to fuse Kyurem with Reshiram or Zekrom.

legendaries.name: Meloetta
legendaries.method: Spawns naturally in sunflower plains at level 50–55.

legendaries.name: Genesect
legendaries.method: Spawns naturally in dripstone caves at level 48–68.

legendaries.name: Xerneas, Yveltal & Zygarde
legendaries.method: Xerneas appears in floral biomes by day and Yveltal in spooky biomes at night (both level 65–75, very rare). Zygarde spawns at level 1–10 in dripstone and lush caves — Mega Showdown's Zygarde Cores let it assemble its forms.

legendaries.name: Kalos Mythicals
legendaries.method: Diancie spawns in lush caves (level 45–68), Hoopa in the End (level 65–75) and Volcanion in mountains (level 70).

legendaries.name: Type: Null & Silvally
legendaries.method: Team Rocket Scientists drop the Fossilized Helmet — revive it in the Resurrection Machine to create Type: Null. It evolves into Silvally at 160 friendship.

legendaries.name: Island Guardians (Tapus)
legendaries.method: All four Tapus spawn naturally at level 50–70 under open sky: Tapu Koko in savannas and jungles, Tapu Lele in floral biomes and beaches, Tapu Bulu along rivers and jungles, and Tapu Fini along rivers and beaches.

legendaries.name: Cosmog line (Solgaleo & Lunala)
legendaries.method: Cosmog spawns in the End (level 28–42) and evolves into Cosmoem at level 43, then into Solgaleo (level 53, daytime) or Lunala (level 53, night). Both also spawn directly — Solgaleo in sunny savannas and the End, Lunala in spooky biomes at night and the End.

legendaries.name: Necrozma
legendaries.method: Necrozma spawns in the End at level 70–75. Its fused forms wait in dedicated End towers: the Necrozma Dusk Radar (built with an N Solarizer) locates the Dusk Tower for Dusk Mane, and the Necrozma Dawn Radar (with an N Lunarizer) the Dawn Tower for Dawn Wings.

legendaries.name: Ultra Beasts
legendaries.method: Ultra Beasts spawn naturally, mostly in the End and extreme biomes: Nihilego in oceans, Buzzwole in jungles, Pheromosa in Terralith steppes and the End, Xurkitree, Celesteela and Guzzlord in the End, Kartana in cherry groves, Stakataka in the deep dark, Blacephalon in spooky biomes, and Poipole at the End's Dawn and Dusk Towers.

legendaries.name: Alolan Mythicals
legendaries.method: Magearna spawns in taigas (level 50–85), Marshadow in the deep dark (level 45–68) and Zeraora in badlands and forests (level 45–85).

legendaries.name: Meltan & Melmetal
legendaries.method: Meltan spawns near placed iron blocks anywhere in the overworld (level 38–48) and on beaches. It evolves into Melmetal at level 70 — while holding an anvil.

legendaries.name: Zacian & Zamazenta
legendaries.method: Both heroes spawn in dark forests at level 65–80. The Rusted Sword (Luna Henge ruins, Zacian raid bosses) and Rusted Shield (Sol Henge ruins, Zamazenta raid bosses) unlock their Crowned forms.

legendaries.name: Eternatus
legendaries.method: Eternatus slumbers in the Eternatus Cocoon, a Legendary Monuments structure generating in the End highlands and midlands. Mine and smelt Galar Particles from Galar Particle Ore, press nine into a Galar Particle Block, and craft the Eternatus Radar to track the cocoon. Eternatus emerges at level 70–90.

legendaries.name: Kubfu & Urshifu
legendaries.method: Kubfu spawns in cherry groves (level 30–50). Use a Scroll of Darkness for Single Strike Urshifu or a Scroll of Waters for Rapid Strike. Urshifu itself also spawns in cherry groves at level 60–80.

legendaries.name: Zarude
legendaries.method: Spawns naturally in jungles at level 70.

legendaries.name: Regieleki & Regidrago
legendaries.method: Both new golems share the Split-Decision Temple (level 70–80), located with the Split-Decision Radar — like the Crown Tundra original, the temple binds Regieleki and Regidrago to a single choice.

legendaries.name: Calyrex, Glastrier & Spectrier
legendaries.method: The Calyrex Ice Rider Radar locates the Crown Spire, home of Glastrier (level 60), while the Shadow Rider Radar finds the Crown Cemetery and Spectrier. Both radars require the Reins of Unity. A Calyrex Crown found within these sites, placed upon the statue, summons Calyrex itself (level 50–70) — the Reins then fuse it with its steed.

legendaries.name: Treasures of Ruin
legendaries.method: Four cursed shrines from Legendary Monuments hold the Treasures of Ruin. Their seals drop from Nether loot (bastion, nether fortress and ruined portal chests); combine each seal with a Dark Tera Shard, the matching type gem and a Poké Radar to craft its shrine radar: Wo-Chien Radar → Grasswither Shrine, Chien-Pao Radar → Icerend Shrine, Ting-Lu Radar → Groundblight Shrine and Chi-Yu Radar → Firescourge Shrine. Wo-Chien, Chien-Pao, Ting-Lu and Chi-Yu appear at their shrines at levels 65–80.

legendaries.name: Koraidon & Miraidon
legendaries.method: Both box legends spawn naturally on beaches under open sky at level 40.

legendaries.name: Loyal Three & Ogerpon
legendaries.method: Okidogi roams savannas, Munkidori jungles and Fezandipiti mountain peaks (all level 70–75); Ogerpon spawns in lush biomes at level 50–75.

legendaries.name: Terapagos & Pecharunt
legendaries.method: Terapagos spawns in deep caves below Y=0 on amethyst blocks (level 55–75). Pecharunt appears in spooky biomes at level 60–80.

legendaries.name: Paradox Pokémon
legendaries.method: All Paradox Pokémon are natural spawns rather than summons — e.g. Great Tusk in arid biomes, Flutter Mane in spooky biomes and the deep dark, Roaring Moon in mountains at night, Iron Treads in arid mountains, Iron Valiant in plains during thunderstorms, Walking Wake in rainy mountains and Gouging Fire in basalt deltas. Check each species' Pokédex entry for exact conditions.
